model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions (k) and coverage for different models, including Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and is on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2^0 to 2^8, with tick labels at powers of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" and is on a linear scale, ranging from 0.4 to 0.9, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot includes four lines: Llama-3B (dark blue, solid line), Llama-3B + FT (green triangles, dashed line), Llama-1B (light blue, solid line), and Llama-1B + FT (light green triangles, dashed line). The dark blue line starts at approximately 0.42 at 2^0 and increases to around 0.93 at 2^8. The green dashed line with triangles starts at about 0.43 at 2^0 and reaches 0.94 at 2^8. The light blue line begins at roughly 0.38 at 2^0 and rises to approximately 0.86 at 2^8. The light green dashed line with triangles starts at around 0.39 at 2^0 and goes up to about 0.88 at 2^8. All lines exhibit an overall increasing trend as the number of completions increases.
